summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Skiller. 17/17 backend pytest cases passed (auth, posts, users, courses, gigs, follow, like, comment, profile update, gig apply, no-_id leakage). Frontend e2e via Playwright validated landing, login, feed (6 seeded posts), like, comment, explore, courses (4 cards - 'React Mastery' visible), gigs (5 - 'Landing page' visible), gig apply dialog send, upload (1x1 PNG -> redirect to /feed, new post with caption 'TEST_upload from playwright' visible), profile /u/arjun shows follow button, theme toggle (in app sidebar) flips html.dark class, logout clears localStorage skiller_token and returns to landing.

issues: Theme toggle data-testid='theme-toggle' is only present inside the authenticated Layout sidebar, not on the public landing/login pages. Spec mentioned 'day/night toggle works' on landing - if intended as public, add it to Landing header.
A11y warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for shadcn DialogContent. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to silence and improve a11y.

action_items: (Optional) Add a public theme toggle on Landing page header if a public day/night switch is required - currently only available after login in sidebar.
(Minor) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to gig Apply dialog (and any other DialogContent) to fix a11y warning.
(Optional UX) Server stores any base64 string as media without size/type validation - consider rejecting empty/oversized payloads (>8MB) or non image/* MIME on POST /api/posts.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: post create POST /api/posts has no media size validation; a malicious client could store arbitrarily large base64 blobs in MongoDB.
server.py: CORS uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' fallback (env CORS_ORIGINS). Wildcard + credentials is invalid per CORS spec; ensure CORS_ORIGINS is explicitly set in production.
server.py: PATCH /api/users/me allows updating arbitrary avatar_url string with no URL validation (could accept javascript: URLs in img src). Validate http(s) or data:image/.
server.py: Endpoints route ordering OK (e.g. /posts/feed, /posts/explore declared before /posts/{post_id}).
server.py: Single 549-line file is acceptable for MVP but starts approaching the 700-line modularization threshold; future split into routers (auth, posts, users, courses, gigs) recommended.
No httpOnly cookie auth - uses Authorization Bearer + localStorage as documented. Acceptable per spec; just be aware of XSS exposure of token.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed test user via /api/auth/register and TEST_ post + TEST_ comment + TEST_ gig application during pytest. TEST_ post was deleted; the playwright-uploaded 1x1 PNG post 'TEST_upload from playwright' remains in feed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py - run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. All 17 currently green. Frontend uses localStorage 'skiller_token' + Bearer header (NOT cookies). Landing has no theme toggle; sidebar [data-testid='theme-toggle'] toggles html.dark. Upload page accepts file input + caption then POSTs base64 to /api/posts and redirects to /feed.
rca of the issue: No critical bugs found. All listed items are enhancements/minor a11y/security hardening, not blocking defects.
